user.title: Itadaki
user.description: Set up Itadaki. AI is optional and is set up later in the panel's Manage page.

list_recipes.name: List recipes
list_recipes.description: Short summaries (id, language, title, parent, relation, image, times, tags shared by the translation group, and every language the dish exists in), newest first. Use get_recipe for full content.

language.name: Language
language.description: Only recipes in this language code, e.g. en, ja.

query.name: Query
query.description: Only recipes whose title contains this text.

prefer_language.name: Prefer language
prefer_language.description: Show each dish once, in this language when a translation exists.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Only recipes with every one of these tag ids: recipe tags, or ingredient tags of an ingredient the recipe uses.

get_recipe.name: Get recipe
get_recipe.description: Full recipe, its ingredient lines as display text, its parent, whether it is a stale translation, its translations in other languages and its variants.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale ingredient quantities to this many servings.

create_recipe.name: Create recipe
create_recipe.description: Creates a recipe. Fields: language (required), title (required), description, servings, prep_minutes, cook_minutes, total_minutes, ingredients, steps (each with text, section), notes, tags (recipe tag ids from list_tags; shared by a recipe and its translations, so setting them on one sets them on all), image_url, source_url. Each ingredient line has ingredient_id (required, from the ingredient list), quantity, unit_id (from the unit list), note, section. Create missing ingredients first with upsert_ingredient.

parent_id.name: Parent ID
parent_id.description: Makes this a child of that recipe. Requires relation.

relation.name: Relation
relation.description: translation (same dish, other language) or variant (changed dish).

update_recipe.name: Update recipe
update_recipe.description: Changes only the given fields; lists are replaced whole. Every edit makes this recipe's translations stale.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

changes.name: Changes
changes.description: Fields to change, same names as in create_recipe.

delete_recipe.name: Delete recipe
delete_recipe.description: Deletes a recipe. Refused if it has translations or variants unless cascade is on.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

cascade.name: Cascade
cascade.description: Also delete all its translations and variants.

mark_translation_synced.name: Mark translation up to date
mark_translation_synced.description: Clears the stale flag of a translation without re-translating it.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

get_settings.name: Get settings
get_settings.description: Library settings: languages, the languages every ingredient and unit is named in and recipes are translated into; instructions, the standing instructions sent with every run of each AI action (extract, structure, translate, adapt, tag).

update_settings.name: Update settings
update_settings.description: Changes only the given settings. Removing a language keeps the names already written in it.

languages.name: Languages
languages.description: Language codes, e.g. en, ja. At least one.

instructions.name: Standing instructions
instructions.description: Admins only. Per AI action (extract, structure, translate, adapt, tag): text sent with every run of that AI action, before the request's own note. Empty sends none.

upload_image.name: Upload image
upload_image.description: Stores a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, at most 8 MB) and returns its image_url, to set on a recipe with update_recipe. Photos no recipe uses are deleted a day later.

get_ai_settings.name: Get AI settings
get_ai_settings.description: The AI provider settings, without the API key: enabled (whether AI actions are available), base_url, model, models per action, structured_output, extra_body, api_key_set.

update_ai_settings.name: Update AI settings
update_ai_settings.description: Admins only. Changes only the given settings. An empty api_key keeps the current one; an empty base_url or model turns AI off.

base_url.name: API URL
base_url.description: Any OpenAI-compatible API. For Cloudflare Workers AI, the account's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ending in /ai/v1.

model.name: Model
model.description: Used for every AI action without its own model.

models.name: Models per action
models.description: Per AI action (extract, structure, translate, adapt, tag): a model for that action only.

structured_output.name: JSON enforcement
structured_output.description: schema (strict), json (JSON mode) or off (prompt only), depending on what the provider supports.

extra_body.name: Extra request fields
extra_body.description: Sent with every request. For Gemma on Workers AI, set chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking to false.

list_ingredients.name: List ingredients
list_ingredients.description: All ingredients with their names, plurals and aliases per language, and density.

upsert_ingredient.name: Create or update ingredient
upsert_ingredient.description: Without id creates one. With id updates it: localized merges per language (language code to name, plural, aliases; null removes a language), other fields are replaced. A word may mean only one ingredient per language.

ingredient.name: Ingredient
ingredient.description: Object with id (optional), localized, density (grams per ml), tags (ingredient tag ids from list_tags).

delete_ingredient.name: Delete ingredient
delete_ingredient.description: Refused while any recipe uses it.

list_units.name: List units
list_units.description: All units with names, plurals and aliases per language, dimension, size in base units (g, ml, items) and measurement systems.

upsert_unit.name: Create or update unit
upsert_unit.description: Same rules as upsert_ingredient. Fields: id, localized, dimension (mass, volume, count, other), factor, systems (metric, us, imperial, japanese).

delete_unit.name: Delete unit
delete_unit.description: Refused while any recipe uses it.

merge_ingredient.name: Merge ingredients
merge_ingredient.description: Folds a duplicate ingredient into another: every recipe and inbox draft switches to the target, the duplicate's names become the target's aliases, and the duplicate is deleted.

source_id.name: Duplicate ID
source_id.description: The ingredient to remove, from list_ingredients.

target_id.name: Target ID
target_id.description: The ingredient to keep, from list_ingredients.

merge_unit.name: Merge units
merge_unit.description: Same as merge_ingredient, for units. Quantities are not converted.

source_id.name: Duplicate ID
source_id.description: The unit to remove, from list_units.

target_id.name: Target ID
target_id.description: The unit to keep, from list_units.

list_tags.name: List tags
list_tags.description: Recipe and ingredient tags, each with id, kind (recipe or ingredient) and localized names (language code to name and aliases).

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Only tags of this kind: recipe or ingredient.

upsert_tag.name: Create or update tag
upsert_tag.description: Without id creates one. With id updates it: localized merges per language (language code to name and aliases; null removes a language). A word may mean only one tag of each kind per language. The kind cannot change after creation.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Object with id (optional), kind (recipe or ingredient, default recipe), localized.

delete_tag.name: Delete tag
delete_tag.description: Deletes a tag and removes it from every recipe, ingredient and inbox draft.

tag_id.name: Tag ID
tag_id.description: ID of the tag, from list_tags.

merge_tag.name: Merge tags
merge_tag.description: Folds a duplicate tag into another of the same kind: everything tagged with the duplicate gets the target, the duplicate's names become the target's aliases, and the duplicate is deleted.

source_id.name: Duplicate ID
source_id.description: The tag to remove, from list_tags.

target_id.name: Target ID
target_id.description: The tag to keep, from list_tags.

catalog_usage.name: Catalog usage
catalog_usage.description: Which recipes use each ingredient, unit and tag: ingredients, units and recipe_tags map an id to recipe summaries (a recipe tag is listed on the original of each translation group); ingredient_tags maps an id to the ingredients carrying it. Unused entries are absent.

import_url.name: Import recipe from URL
import_url.description: Imports a recipe from a web page that embeds recipe data, without AI: returns a draft_id whose draft is ready at once. Its ingredient lines are still raw text (raw_lines); structure them with structure_draft, or match them by hand, before save_draft. A page without embedded data is refused; extract_url imports it with AI.

extract_url.name: Import recipe from URL with AI
extract_url.description: For pages without embedded recipe data: the AI reads the page text and writes the whole recipe, following the standing extract instructions and the note. Runs in the background: returns a draft_id at once; poll get_draft until its status is ready (or failed), then review and save_draft. With save on, the result is saved automatically when done.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional instructions for the AI, e.g. convert to metric or make it vegetarian. They win over the standing instructions.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off returns an unsaved draft to review and pass to save_draft.

structure_lines.name: Structure ingredient lines
structure_lines.description: Turns free-text ingredient lines into structured lines linked to the ingredient and unit lists, proposing new ingredients for unknown ones.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: List of strings, or of objects with text and section.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional extra instructions for the AI, e.g. convert to metric, skip the dessert.

translate.name: Translate recipe
translate.description: Translates a recipe into another language as a translation child. If one exists it is updated, sending only changed text. Runs in the background: returns a draft_id at once; poll get_draft until its status is ready (or failed), then review and save_draft. With save on, the result is saved automatically when done.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional extra instructions for the AI, e.g. convert to metric, skip the dessert.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off returns an unsaved draft to review and pass to save_draft.

adapt.name: Adapt recipe
adapt.description: Rewrites a recipe following an instruction, e.g. make it vegetarian or simplify it. Runs in the background: returns a draft_id at once; poll get_draft until its status is ready (or failed), then review and save_draft. With save on, the result is saved automatically when done.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

as_variant.name: As new variant
as_variant.description: Save as a variant child instead of editing the recipe itself.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off returns an unsaved draft to review and pass to save_draft.

suggest_tags.name: Suggest tags with AI
suggest_tags.description: Adds recipe tags that fit the recipe, picked from the existing ones, plus up to three new ones when nothing fits. Runs in the background and returns a draft_id at once; poll get_draft until ready, then review and save_draft.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: ID of the recipe, from list_recipes.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off returns an unsaved draft to review and pass to save_draft.

adapt_draft.name: Adapt draft
adapt_draft.description: Rewrites a ready draft following an instruction, keeping it in the inbox, e.g. after an import. Runs in the background: the draft goes back to working; poll get_draft until it is ready again, then review and save_draft. If the AI fails, the draft stays ready as it was, with the error.

draft_id.name: Draft ID
draft_id.description: ID returned by import_url, translate or adapt, or from list_drafts.

draft.name: Edited draft
draft.description: Optional: the draft content as edited in review; without it the stored draft is used.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off returns an unsaved draft to review and pass to save_draft.

structure_draft.name: Structure draft ingredients
structure_draft.description: Structures a ready draft's raw ingredient lines (raw_lines), e.g. after import_url, linking them to the ingredient and unit lists and proposing new ingredients. Runs in the background like adapt_draft.

draft_id.name: Draft ID
draft_id.description: ID returned by import_url, or from list_drafts.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional extra instructions for the AI, e.g. convert to metric.

draft.name: Edited draft
draft.description: Optional: the draft content as edited in review; without it the stored draft is used.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off returns an unsaved draft to review and pass to save_draft.

tag_draft.name: Suggest tags for draft
tag_draft.description: Adds fitting recipe tags to a ready draft, keeping it in the inbox. Runs in the background: the draft goes back to working; poll get_draft until it is ready again.

draft_id.name: Draft ID
draft_id.description: ID of a ready draft, from list_drafts.

draft.name: Edited draft
draft.description: Optional: the draft content as edited in review; without it the stored draft is used.

save.name: Save
save.description: Save the result directly. Off keeps it in the inbox for review.

save_draft.name: Save draft
save_draft.description: Saves a ready draft, including its new ingredients and catalog names, and removes it from the inbox.

draft_id.name: Draft ID
draft_id.description: ID returned by import_url, translate or adapt, or from list_drafts.

draft.name: Edited draft
draft.description: Optional: the draft content as edited in review; without it the stored draft is saved.

list_drafts.name: List drafts
list_drafts.description: The drafts inbox: AI work in progress (working), results waiting for review (ready) and failures (failed), each with what was asked and the recipe it started from, without their content.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: Only drafts started from this recipe.

get_draft.name: Get draft
get_draft.description: A draft with its status, error and content: the unsaved recipe, its proposed new ingredients, raw ingredient lines still being structured, and display text for the structured lines. A ready draft may carry the error of AI work that failed on it; its unstructured lines are then finished by hand.

draft_id.name: Draft ID
draft_id.description: ID returned by import_url, translate or adapt, or from list_drafts.

discard_draft.name: Discard draft
discard_draft.description: Removes a draft from the inbox without saving it.

draft_id.name: Draft ID
draft_id.description: ID returned by import_url, translate or adapt, or from list_drafts.

apply_draft.name: Apply draft
apply_draft.description: Saves a draft object directly, without the inbox: a recipe plus the new ingredients and catalog names it needs. With updates_id it replaces that recipe's content; with parent_id and relation it creates a child; otherwise a new recipe. All catalog changes are checked before any is applied.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: Object with recipe, and optionally updates_id, parent_id, relation, new_ingredients, added_names.
